Under rainbow every button lights up in a colour of its own, and a pasted video page downloads its video.

## 🎨 Design

- **Under rainbow every button lights up in a colour of its own.** KnightLoader follows GlimStone 3.8.5, which the Components card names. The buttons of a page count through the palette in the order they stand, so two buttons side by side on a card no longer light up alike when the pointer or the keyboard reaches them. Glyph buttons and link badges count too, and a button with its own colour keeps it.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A pasted video page downloads its video.** With "Follow pages and collect the files they link to" on, a pasted page that plays a video and links a few screenshots got crawled for the screenshots, and the video never reached yt-dlp. KnightLoader now asks yt-dlp about the page first. If yt-dlp finds a video or a playlist there, the page goes to yt-dlp and is not crawled. If it finds nothing, the page is crawled for its files as before.
